page.layout: One page of text; a brace-structured conjugation synopsis in the body; a page number top left; running head centred above the text. No marginal notes.

main_text.head: Cum ego
main_text.l: Io hauero, | Tu hauerai, | Colui hauerà, | Wann ich werd, | Wann du wirst, | Wann er wird,
potuero. | tu poueris. | ille potuerit. | haben gekônt.
Noi hauereмo, | Voi hauerete, | Coloro haueranno,
main_text.p: Cum nos potuerimus, vos potueritis, illi potuerint. Wann wir werden haben, jhr werdet haben, sie werden haben, gekônt.
main_text.head: Infinitiuo modo. Temp. præs.
main_text.p: Præterit. Hauer potuto, gekônt haben, potuisse.
main_text.head: Gerundium.
main_text.p: Potendo colui, weil er kan, oder als er kondte, potendo egli far il tutto, weil er alles kan, hauendo potuto, cum potuerim, weil er gekôndt, hauendo a potere io, &c. Nach dem ich werd gekônt haben, cum potuero, dovendo potere colui, wann er solt gekônt haben, cum ille potuerit, essendo voi per potere, nach dem ich werde gekônt haben. Weil jhr werdet gekônt haben.

page.notes: Several lines of the conjugation synopsis are set in a brace layout; the diagram lines are approximated. Some Italian and German words are doubtful, notably "hauereмo" which contains a Cyrillic-looking letter in the scan and should read hauerêmo. The final word "DE-" is a catchword-like fragment at the foot, shown as a running word of the next signature and not transcribed.
